Stream and traceback output are notebook content rendered by StreamOutput; output-type selection is not an application error state.
The toolbar badge reports parse validity and cell metadata; its text does not replace the InlineError shown for an invalid notebook.
This changes the mode-toggle label between Notebook and Source; it is selection text, not a request state.
Python toolbar controls are available only in rich Python mode; this is control eligibility, not loading, empty, or error.
This chooses the selected-interpreter label or Select Kernel fallback; it is control text, not an empty environment result.
Interrupt is shown only while the runtime is busy; availability of a decisive action is not a surface state.
Restart is available only for ready or dead kernels; this is control eligibility, not a pending or error render.
The local Find toolbar is open only while its draft is active; it is a transient editor mode, not a request outcome.
This selects source editing versus the rich cell view; it is the editor mode, not a loading, empty, or error result.
Cell pagination controls appear only when the document exceeds one page; this is bounded navigation availability, not an empty state.
Execution-count metadata is shown only on code cells; cell-type eligibility is presentation, not a surface state.
This chooses a stored execution count versus the running marker; execution count is advisory output metadata, not loading or error.
The Run cell control is available only for code cells; this is action eligibility, not a loading, empty, or error state.
This switches the Edit cell button label for the current local edit mode; it is not loading, empty, or error.
Clear outputs applies only to code cells; this condition controls action availability, not a UI state.
This selects the local cell editor or preformatted source preview; editing mode is not a loading, empty, or error outcome.

The environment section is visible only while the picker is open; dialog/menu visibility is not a completed empty result.
A positive environment inventory renders selectable choices; choice-list presence is ordinary content, not an empty state.
The trust dialog is an explicit execution-consent prompt; its open state is neither loading, empty, nor an error result.
This varies the confirmation button label for the captured Run all versus Run cell request; it is prompt copy, not a surface state.
The setup dialog is an explicit setup-confirmation prompt; visibility is not loading, empty, or error.
This chooses the Create .venv versus Install confirmation label from the captured setup prompt; prompt copy is not loading, empty, or error.
